items.title: Expo/package compatibility is verified when tooling/network is available
deviceSteps: Run expo-doctor and expo install --check with network/tooling available.
Record warnings/errors without auto-changing dependencies during acceptance.
Re-run TypeScript and acceptance preflight after any separately approved dependency correction.
items.expected: Package/tooling health is recorded explicitly; any dependency correction is handled as a separate reviewed change rather than silently folded into device evidence.
items.evidence: Captured expo-doctor and expo install --check output with date and environment versions.

items.title: Preview APK installs and launches on representative Android devices
deviceSteps: Build the approved preview APK outside this harness workflow.
Install on at least one gesture-navigation device and one three-button-navigation device or equivalent emulator profiles.
Launch, relaunch, and exercise core navigation.
items.expected: The preview APK installs, launches, persists state, and exposes no blocking native crash across the representative matrix.
items.evidence: Build identifier plus device/OS matrix with install/launch result for each row.

items.title: Settings inventory edits serialize to native renderers
deviceSteps: Edit a registered node used by Widget or floating overlay.
Save the edit from the app Settings inventory.
Refresh or reopen the target native surface.
items.expected: The native surface consumes the persisted node settings without requiring a React Native modal while the app is closed.
items.evidence: Before/after screenshots of the editor setting and corresponding native surface.

items.title: Universal Editor touch ergonomics and long-list scrolling
deviceSteps: Open Universal Editor from a registered node.
Expand sections with long content, including Effects and Advanced.
Scroll to the bottom, edit controls, then use Cancel/Reset/Save.
items.expected: Section headers, controls, scrolling, and fixed footer remain usable without accidental activation or unreachable content.
items.evidence: Screen recording of a full top-to-bottom editor interaction.

items.title: Last input remains visible above IME
deviceSteps: Open the longest active form.
Focus the last editable field using Gboard or the OEM keyboard.
Scroll while the keyboard is open and rotate once if supported.
items.expected: The focused field and fixed action footer stay visible and reachable above the keyboard.
items.evidence: Screenshots or recording showing the final input with the IME open.

items.title: Keyboard avoidance survives rotation and large fonts
deviceSteps: Enable large system font scaling.
Open an active form and focus a lower field.
Rotate portrait to landscape and back while the IME is visible where device policy permits.
items.expected: No input becomes permanently hidden and the user can still reach Save/Cancel actions.
items.evidence: Device/OS/font-scale notes with screenshots for portrait and landscape.

items.title: Compact monitor templates fit bounded overlay sizes
deviceSteps: Select each compact/small monitor template.
Test minimum supported overlay size.
Verify fixed header/body/summary/footer regions remain usable.
items.expected: Compact templates do not clip essential controls or overlap fixed regions at minimum supported size.
items.evidence: One screenshot per compact template at minimum size.

items.title: Large/dense monitor templates remain usable across resize range
deviceSteps: Select each large/dense template.
Resize from minimum to a large window size.
Verify rows, columns, controls, and summary at both extremes.
items.expected: Large/dense templates preserve readable columns and stable controls throughout the supported resize range.
items.evidence: Minimum/maximum size screenshots for each large/dense template.

items.title: Standard monitor templates render all configured fields
deviceSteps: Select each standard monitor template.
Populate enough holdings/watchlist rows to require scrolling.
Verify title, status, body, and summary content.
items.expected: Standard templates render configured fields, scroll only the bounded body, and retain fixed header/summary/footer.
items.evidence: One screenshot per standard template plus one scroll recording.

items.title: Overlay advanced effects degrade compatibly
deviceSteps: Apply gradient/glow/shadow/shimmer/sweep capable node settings.
Open the native overlay.
Compare semantic colors and emphasis with the in-app editor preview.
items.expected: Native fallback preserves semantic color/emphasis and remains legible even where blur or continuous animation is unsupported.
items.evidence: Side-by-side screenshots of editor preview and overlay.

items.title: Floating overlay close, minimize, restore, drag and resize lifecycle
deviceSteps: Open the floating monitor.
Drag and resize it, then minimize and restore it.
Close the window and reopen it from the app without restarting the service manually.
items.expected: Position/size interactions work, minimize/restore is stable, and close/reopen follows the configured lifecycle without stale or duplicated windows.
items.evidence: Screen recording covering drag, resize, minimize, restore, close, and reopen.

items.title: Floating overlay permission and OEM policy handling
deviceSteps: Start with overlay permission denied.
Request permission and enable the floating monitor.
Background the app and observe behavior under the device OEM background policy.
items.expected: Permission denial is recoverable, enabling succeeds after permission grant, and OEM restrictions fail gracefully without corrupting app state.

items.title: Flow layout scales across screen widths and font sizes
deviceSteps: Test a narrow phone width and a large phone/tablet width.
Enable larger accessibility font scaling.
Inspect cards using each supported quick width.
items.expected: Cards wrap without overlap, preserve order, and remain readable at narrow/large widths and enlarged fonts.
items.evidence: Screenshots for narrow, large, and accessibility-font cases.

items.title: Immersive navigation reapplies after foregrounding
deviceSteps: Launch the app and note navigation visibility.
Send the app to background and return to foreground.
Repeat after opening and closing an editor.
items.expected: Configured immersive navigation is restored after foreground transitions without trapping the user in an unusable state.
items.evidence: Short screen recording covering background/foreground and editor open/close.

items.title: System navigation and safe-area behavior
deviceSteps: Test gesture navigation and three-button navigation.
Open every active V3 tab and verify bottom controls remain above the system navigation area.
Repeat on a device or emulator with display cutout simulation enabled.
items.expected: No active screen, modal footer, tab control, or floating action control is obscured by Android system bars or cutouts.
items.evidence: Screenshots for gesture and three-button navigation plus device/OS notes.

items.title: Watchlist quote subscriptions survive reconnect and app update
deviceSteps: Keep at least one watchlist-only ETF visible.
Disconnect and reconnect the network and confirm quote recovery.
After a compatible update/relaunch, confirm watchlist-only symbols still subscribe without entering portfolio calculations.
items.expected: Watchlist-only symbols recover live quotes and remain display-only across reconnect/relaunch/update.
items.evidence: Recording or timestamped screenshots before disconnect, after reconnect, and after relaunch/update.

items.title: Watchlist persists independently across relaunch and offline state
deviceSteps: Add and reorder watchlist symbols that are not holdings.
Force-close and relaunch the app.
Repeat once with network unavailable.
items.expected: Watchlist membership/order persists without creating accounting holdings or ledger records, including offline relaunch.
items.evidence: Before/after screenshots plus exported or inspected holding count showing no accounting row was created.

items.title: Widget paint fallbacks remain readable
deviceSteps: Apply theme/P&L colors and advanced effects to Widget-bound nodes.
Refresh the launcher Widget.
Check positive, negative, and neutral values.
items.expected: Unsupported paint/effect primitives degrade to readable fixed/P&L colors without losing semantic state.
items.evidence: Launcher screenshots covering positive, negative, neutral, and at least one degraded effect.

items.title: Widget refresh and click behavior
deviceSteps: Add the Widget to the launcher.
Trigger its supported refresh interaction and observe the update timestamp/data.
Use the configured open-app interaction.
items.expected: Refresh does not zero valid data, update feedback is visible, and the open-app interaction reaches the expected app destination.
items.evidence: Screen recording from launcher refresh through app open.
